notes: The left half of a samgyupsal grill table: a square top of dark wood on four legs, a round charcoal grill set in its left side with strips of pork belly on the grate, and three dishes of banchan on its right.
Place both halves by pixel (px) on one point, the middle of its top: the food stands there, placed after it. Its legs run out of the brief's box at the bottom.
States: sizzle (6 frames, 200 ms each, looping: the smoke rises and the coals glow), idle (still).
